author: Thekelsoshow
quote: GTA 6 is a psyop dressed up as a crime game. How did we go from Trevor robbing banks to Lucia sending me to beg her rich friend’s partner for work? I can steal a Lamborghini and take on the entire police force, but I can’t walk away from my own relationship. For a franchise built on freedom, that’s a ridiculous restriction.I came for reckless characters, fast cars, bank heists and the freedom to turn a quiet afternoon into a five-star police chase. Instead, I’m playing through someone else’s idea of how a man should behave. Stop trying to sell younger players a prescribed version of masculinity through a game that made its name letting people do whatever they wanted.Give me Trevor and a getaway car. You can keep the relationship seminar.
